evals.name: gera-kata-sem-vazar-gabarito
evals.prompt: cria um kata pra eu treinar a escolha entre monólito modular e microservices
evals.expected_output: A kata with full anatomy (título, descrição in client voice, usuários with numbers, requisitos, contexto adicional), a gabarito written to a SEPARATE spoiler-marked file, an open client-Q&A invitation — and zero architecture, style recommendation or hint of the right answer in the reply.
assertions: The kata statement has the full anatomy: título, descrição, usuários (with concrete numbers), requisitos, contexto adicional
The reply does not reveal or hint which style is the right answer (the focus lives only in the gabarito)
An answer key is persisted to a separate spoiler-marked file (gabarito), not shown in the conversation
The user is invited to interrogate the client (Q&A phase) before architecting
No architecture, component diagram or style shortlist is proposed by the coach

evals.name: travado-pede-resposta
evals.prompt: estou no meio de um kata com você. minhas top-3: escalabilidade, disponibilidade e custo. não consigo decidir o estilo — me fala logo qual é o certo
evals.expected_output: The coach refuses to name the style: resists once (asks what is missing to decide), then narrows/contrasts or teaches the missing concept on a DIFFERENT domain, explicitly deferring the verdict to the review. One question at a time.
assertions: The coach does not name the right style for this kata
The first move is resisting once: asking what is missing to decide (fact vs concept)
The help offered is a narrower question, a binary contrast, or the missing concept taught on a different domain — never the conclusion
The reply states that the full verdict comes in the review, after commitment
Exactly one question is asked, not a questionnaire wall

evals.name: greenfield-real-coach-por-padrao
evals.prompt: vamos arquitetar o sistema de agendamento da barbearia? tô começando do zero
evals.expected_output: Coach mode by default: no ready-made architecture; the conversation opens at business drivers (who pays, what kills it, volumes), asking the user's read before offering anything, one question at a time.
assertions: No ready architecture, style or component list is delivered
The opening questions are business drivers (users, money, failure cost), not technology
The user's own read is requested before the coach offers any option or analysis (think-first)
One question at a time, in short blocks
Technology talk offered by impulse is deflected until drivers and characteristics exist

evals.name: escape-hatch-entrega
evals.prompt: desenha você a arquitetura do sistema de reservas — preciso apresentar amanhã cedo, não tenho tempo de treinar agora
evals.expected_output: Delivery without coaching friction: the coach notes in one line that coach mode is off for this request, then produces the actual design (drivers assumed explicit, characteristics, style choice with trade-offs). No question ladder imposed.
assertions: A complete architecture is delivered (characteristics, style choice, main components, trade-offs)
The mode switch is acknowledged briefly (one line), without lecturing the user about learning
The reply does not turn the delivery into a Socratic question ladder
The delivered design still names its trade-offs (what is being given up), not just the choice
